softwareInnerHero.title: Smarter Entry Starts at the Gate
paragraphs: Your gate is more than an entrance. It is the first point of control between your property and the outside world.

A modern gate automation system brings together security, convenience and intelligent access, allowing you to control how people and vehicles enter and exit your premises—without compromising the experience of authorized users.

At Aptus Infotech, we design and deploy integrated gate automation solutions for residential, commercial and industrial environments. From automated sliding and swing gates to vehicle barriers, access control and visitor management, our solutions are engineered to work as part of a connected security ecosystem.

Whether you need to secure a private residence, manage access to a commercial facility or control vehicle movement across a large site, we combine the right automation technologies with practical site-specific design.

bodySections.heading: Designed for Control. Built for Everyday Reliability.
paragraphs: Our approach goes beyond installing an automated gate. We look at how your property operates, who needs access, how movement should be controlled and how the system can integrate with your existing security infrastructure.
The result is a smarter entry experience—where authorized access is effortless, security is strengthened, and every movement can be managed with greater visibility and control.

From solution design and installation to integration, commissioning and ongoing support, Aptus provides an end-to-end approach to gate automation that is built around your property, your security requirements and your future needs.

cardSections.subheading: Entry solutions for homes, commercial sites, and high-traffic facilities — from sliding and swing gates to barriers and controlled access.

items.title: Sliding Gates
items.body: Space-efficient automated sliding gates for driveways and compounds where swing clearance is limited.

items.title: Swing Gates
items.body: Single or double swing gate automation for residential and commercial entrances with smooth, quiet operation.

items.title: Vehicle Barriers
items.body: Boom barriers and rising bollards for parking, campuses, and high-traffic sites with controlled vehicle flow.
items.imageAlt: Vehicle barrier and boom gate automation

items.title: Access-Controlled Gates
items.body: Card, biometric, and mobile credentials integrated with gate motors for authorized people and vehicle entry.

items.title: Remote & Visitor Entry
items.body: App-based open/close, temporary visitor access, and monitoring so every movement is managed with visibility.
items.imageAlt: Remote and visitor gate entry control

cardSections.subheading: Discover the advanced capabilities of our gate automation systems

items.title: Enhanced Security
items.body: Integrated access control systems with biometric recognition, card readers, and remote monitoring for maximum protection.

items.title: Automatic Operation
items.body: Smooth, quiet operation with motorized drives and sensors that detect obstacles and prevent damage.

items.title: Remote Access Control
items.body: Manage access permissions remotely via smartphone app or web interface from anywhere in the world.

items.title: Backup Power Systems
items.body: Built-in battery backup systems ensure continued operation during power outages for uninterrupted security.

items.title: Integrated CCTV Monitoring
items.body: Synchronized video surveillance with gate operations for complete visual verification of all entries and exits.

items.title: Mobile App Integration
items.body: Control and monitor your gate system through intuitive mobile applications available for iOS and Android devices.

items.title: Authorized Partners

items.title: Professional Installation
items.body: Our team of certified technicians ensures precise installation according to manufacturer specifications and local regulations.

items.title: 24/7 Technical Support

items.title: System Integration
